newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close slightly lower, more losses seen.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close slightly lower, more losses seen.

text.p: UK shares finished slightly lower on Thursday as some investors decided to lock in profits ahead of next Tuesday's U.S. Federal Reserve monetary meeting -- deliberations which could prompt a near-term rise in U.S. interest rates.
The FTSE 100 index closed 5.7 points lower at 4,681.2. Dealers said UK blue chips could see more near-term profit-taking following the FTSE's month-long, 10 percent rally.
"This market is still due for a correction. Tomorrow people will start worrying about a Fed rate hike," one senior dealer said.
